enriched_activities.desc: Remains lying on bed. Eyes closed. Breathes steadily. Sleeps. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Continues sleeping. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Sleeps.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and using toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Walk to bathroom. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast (toast, coffee) using toaster and kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour hot water into mug. Add coffee. Stir. Toast pops up. Take out toast. Spread butter. Eat and drink. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Put wallet in bag. Put phone in bag. Put keys in bag. Walk out.

Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Receive handover from night shift. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Record patient information. Assist doctor with procedure. Communicate with patient. Wash hands. Prepare medical equipment. Clean wounds. Change bandages. Monitor IV drip. Respond to call button. Consult with colleague. Update patient charts. Attend team meeting. Take phone call.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating and resting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Check phone. Talk with colleague. Clear tray. Walk to break room. Sit on chair. Close eyes. Rest. Walk back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Record patient information. Assist doctor with procedure. Communicate with patient. Wash hands. Prepare medical equipment. Clean wounds. Change bandages. Monitor IV drip. Respond to call button. Consult with colleague. Update patient charts. Attend team meeting. Take phone call.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit down. Check phone. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock front door. Enter home. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner using induction cooker and refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add seasoning. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Serve food. Eat dinner. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using personal computer and phone for leisure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open computer. Turn on computer. Wait for boot. Open browser. Check email. Browse social media. Open phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put down phone. Continue browsing. Play game. Watch video. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or watching TV to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed: showering and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Brush teeth. Walk to bedroom.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathes steadily. Falls asleep. Turns to side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Turns to back. Stretches legs. Sleeps. Remains asleep.
